title: Varifold weight: finite on compact subsets of U, null off spt V, absolutely continuous with respect to H^n
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U an arbitrary subset of R^{n+l} (no openness is assumed), and V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (the contract structure RectifiableVarifold), with M := V.carrier, theta := V.mult, H^n := muHE[n] on R^{n+l} and weight mu := V.weight = (H^n restricted to M).withDensity (ofReal o theta). Then: (i) mu(K) < infinity for every compact set K contained in U; (ii) mu(R^{n+l} \ spt V) = 0, where spt V = V.support = U cap supp(mu); (iii) every set Z of R^{n+l} with H^n(Z) = 0 (Z arbitrary, not necessarily measurable) satisfies mu(Z) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ K : Set (Amb n ℓ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → V.weight K < ⊤) ∧ V.weight (V.support)ᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ Z : Set (Amb n ℓ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) Z = 0 → V.weight Z = 0
